import unittest

from solution import answer_requests


class AnswerRequestsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dispatch_is_exact_case_sensitive_and_ordered(self):
        index = {"A1": "Primary asset", "PING": "Indexed ping", " spaced ": "Spaces"}
        requests = ["HELP", "PING", "A1", "a1", " spaced ", "spaced", " HELP ", ""]
        result = answer_requests(index, requests)
        self.assertEqual(
            result,
            [
                "Send an asset code.",
                "READY",
                "A1: Primary asset",
                "UNKNOWN: a1",
                " spaced : Spaces",
                "UNKNOWN: spaced",
                "UNKNOWN:  HELP ",
                "UNKNOWN: ",
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(index, {"A1": "Primary asset", "PING": "Indexed ping", " spaced ": "Spaces"})
        self.assertEqual(requests, ["HELP", "PING", "A1", "a1", " spaced ", "spaced", " HELP ", ""])

    def test_empty_requests(self):
        self.assertEqual(answer_requests({}, []), [])

    def test_index_validation(self):
        for index, error in [
            ([], TypeError),
            ({1: "description"}, TypeError),
            ({"": "description"}, ValueError),
            ({"A": 1}, TypeError),
            ({"A": ""}, ValueError),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaises(error):
                    answer_requests(index, [])

    def test_request_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            answer_requests({}, "HELP")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            answer_requests({}, ["A", 2])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            answer_requests({}, [None])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
